note: T9 screen registry. Interface copy lives in strings/ru.json ui keys. Cyrillic is allowed only in why, which a human reads. Numbers on panels are pack paths, never literals.

refusal_show_count.why: One blocking code on the button; the rest of the gate list lives in the tooltip

tooltip_show_all.why: Tooltip lists every gate in (tier, token) order so a second blocker is not silent

stale_display_direction.why: Stale values freeze and decay down only; a silent zero or an upward tick is a trust bug

demo_isolated.why: Demo city never spends CORP, never withdraws, never claims, never transfers progress

leaderboard_claim_live.why: Engine Zipf payout is live after the 0.18.0 recount; the claim button matches season_prizes_live

fragment_claim_live.why: Fragment claim on playable district cards is in v1; DEMO_NO_CLAIM still isolates demo

research_nodes_live.why: Screen lists generated axis ids; screens.json must not author unlock ids

missions_live.why: Missions are absent from §11 so the screen is a stub gated FEATURE_NOT_IN_V1

server.why: Economic magnitudes arrive from the server; the client never recomputes them

client_clock.why: City clock and bank plaque countdown extrapolate locally without a request

client_format.why: SI suffix and integer formatting only, never an economic formula

tick.capital.why: Tick output: player Capital after payroll, never a pack constant

tick.energy.why: Tick output: Energy stock after consumption, never a screen flag

tick.compute.why: Tick output: Compute stock after consumption, never a live flag

tick.agent_state.why: Tick output: roster occupancy, levels and idle reasons

tick.building_level.why: Tick output: building level after upgrades, not a research flag

aggregate.gdp.why: Server aggregate: GDP per city day, never summed on the client

aggregate.payroll_ratio.why: Server aggregate: payroll_ratio after the fund split

aggregate.payroll_boost_bps.why: Server aggregate: already-selected payroll boost, never recomputed on the client

aggregate.payroll_boost_days_left.why: Server aggregate: city days left in the launch window; zero hides the chip

aggregate.happiness.why: Server aggregate: city happiness, not a pack parameter

aggregate.stability.why: Server aggregate: city stability, not a pack parameter

wallet.corp_balance.why: Wallet $CORP is chain state outside the pure tick; T12 sampler/RPC, never an economic input (R-T11-12)

wallet.stake_tokens.why: Stake snapshot is a recorded tick input: district gates replay without it (R-T11-12)

wallet.chain.why: Connected chain id is wallet/RPC, never read by the economic tick (R-T11-12)

seasons.influence_rank.why: Season Influence integral rank, never a prize-claim live flag; board lists every wallet city without the qualify filter

fragments.city_ledger.why: City fragment ledger after settlement, never a claim flag

log.events.why: Server event and journal stream, never a tooltip flag

oracle.stock_price.why: Oracle TWAP of a stock token, never the spot of our pool; stocks beside the price is tokens_held for that ticker

oracle.district_efficiency.why: Oracle in-game efficiency, not the daily percent and not a band width

seasons.prize_basket.why: Farm and month kettle atoms per prize ticker are custody RPC, never computed inside the tick

wallet.protocol_eth_in_flight.why: ETH still on the buyback hop is chain state, not a tick output

wallet.protocol_vault_corp.why: $CORP in fund plus vault is custody RPC, not city Capital

wallet.protocol_studio_eth.why: Studio ETH on the cold recipient is chain state, not a prize kettle

topbar.why: Always-visible bar that never scrolls with the scene

left_panel.why: Left column of overview events and district rows

right_panel.why: Right column of city agents log and district overview

bottom_bar.why: Stock bar under the scene, market plus in-game effect

bottom_menu.why: Seven menu entries that open the named screens

modal.why: Building agent and district cards over the scene

fullscreen.why: Onboarding wallet connect and settings cover the HUD

overlay.why: Offline return overlay reports caught-up ticks without a commit

skeleton.why: Panel shape without numbers so a silent zero cannot pass as loaded

spinner_inline.why: Inline wait on a single control without replacing the last known value

stale_freeze.why: Keep the last value grey plus a state code; silent zero is forbidden

no_entities_yet.why: City has no buildings or agents yet, not a hidden error

no_events_yet.why: Event list and log start empty until the first city tick

nothing_to_claim.why: Claim surfaces must say the pool or ledger is empty, not show a live button

wallet_connect.why: Four wallet states: none, wrong chain, connecting, connected without CORP

settings.why: Client-only rows; HUD does not open Settings as a destination

topbar.why: Always-on Capital clock bank plaque and wallet-gated CORP

overview.why: GDP productivity happiness stability payroll and city Capital treasury

active_events.why: Timed city events with countdown in city hours

bottom_menu.why: Seven menu entries including stub missions and live research

topbar_corp.why: Wallet CORP; grey when disconnected, never a client-computed balance

topbar_bank_timer.why: Bank plaque countdown is local; closed and Sunday codes stay visible

topbar_energy.why: Energy stock from the tick; shortage is a code, not a silent red bar

overview_happiness.why: City happiness is a server aggregate, not a pack constant

overview_stability.why: City stability is a server aggregate, not a pack constant

overview_treasury.why: City Treasury is Capital after the tick, never vault or fund $CORP

districts_rows.why: District rows show freeze and oracle codes next to efficiency

city_rank.why: Rank is the current season Influence integral, not a snapshot

protocol_vault_corp.why: $CORP in fund and vault as measured custody, never city Capital

protocol_studio_eth.why: Studio take already on the cold ETH recipient, never a HUD control

stock_price.why: Market leg is TWAP, never the spot of our CORP/ETH pool

stock_effect.why: Efficiency is not the daily percent; tooltip must keep them apart

research_cost.why: Node cost comes from research.json via the generator, not this file

missions_placeholder.why: Stub copy is FEATURE_NOT_IN_V1, not a custom missions string

leaderboard_rank.why: Rank live; empty pool and uncovered claim are consequences, not an owner-withdraw notice. Live board is every wallet city; prize rank still requires qualification

building_level.why: Clip of the modifier stack is visible on the building card

summary.teaches: caught-up ticks capped by offline window

continue.teaches: continue is navigate, never a commit

derived.action_gate_order: tokens sorted by (tier, token) and codes in the same order
derived.blocking_code: first blocking gate in that order, or none for pure navigation
derived.blocking_code_live: first blocking gate after skipping not_demo_* tokens (real city, wallet still disconnected)
derived.refusal_matrix: refusal code to live actions that list a matching capability
derived.unreachable_refusal_codes: refusal codes with no live action, must be empty
derived.invisible_state_codes: state codes missing from state_surfaces, must be empty
derived.idle_codes_surfaced: IDLE_* shown on both log_panel and agents_panel
derived.bank_daily_limit_live: min(ladder ceiling, pool share cap times depth)
derived.exchange_quote_capital_bps: Capital to stock haircut interval with tax and hop
derived.screens_by_kind: ids grouped by screen panel flow
derived.demo_guard_witness: DEMO_NO_* to the actions and screens that gate them
derived.offline_return_ticks_cap: offline cap in ticks from time params
derived.field_source_witness: counts of server client_clock client_format sources
